payload.posture: Read Acts 5:27–32 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the high priest charges the apostles; Peter answers by naming human killing, divine raising and exaltation, repentance, forgiveness, and witnesses. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
